app.title: Cygnet — multilingual wordnet browser
app.summary: A person types a word, a wildcard pattern, a concept index id or a phrase from a definition, and gets back the senses that match. They can narrow these by language and part of speech. Opening a sense shows its concept: definitions in several languages, examples, and the words that express the concept in every language. A force-directed graph shows the concept's semantic relations and expands when a node is hovered. The person can also ask for the chain of relations between this concept and another one, and open a summary of the coverage and provenance of each source wordnet that was merged.

task.text: Look up a word or concept in a merged multilingual lexical database and follow its meanings, translations and semantic relations to other concepts.

data.text: A merged lexical network. Concepts are linked by typed semantic relations such as hypernymy and meronymy, and each concept is expressed by word senses in many languages. Concepts carry definitions and examples, and every row is traced back to its source resource.
data.item: a concept (synset) with its definitions, word senses across languages and typed relations to other concepts

stage.text: exploring a released merged lexical resource after it is built, and keeping its sources in order

mechanism.text: A search box with four automatically detected modes fills a list of matching senses, which language and part-of-speech filters narrow. Clicking a sense opens a concept page with definitions and lexicalizations, a relation graph that can be switched to a list, and a path finder. Concept links throughout the page show a tooltip on hover and open that concept when clicked, and the URL hash records the current view.

field.text: multilingual wordnets and lexical semantics in computational linguistics

workflow.name: look up an item in a linked network and follow its links

steps.here: The page downloads the gzipped SQLite databases, decompresses them in the browser with sql.js and caches them in IndexedDB. The search box is disabled until they are ready.

steps.step: find items by name, pattern, id or description
steps.here: One box takes an exact word, a glob such as hot* or *ness, an ILI id such as i1234, or def: followed by text to search inside definitions. The mode is detected automatically.

steps.step: filter to the items that matter
steps.here: Under ⚙ Settings, checkboxes restrict results by language and by part of speech, and a selector sets which language definitions and labels are shown in.
Clicking a sense opens its concept view: the main definition, other-language definitions, examples, a pictogram and all forms expressing the concept, grouped by language.

steps.step: follow an item's links to its neighbours
steps.here: A force-directed graph of related concepts, with edges coloured by relation type, expands when a node is hovered. It can be switched to a text list grouped by relation or hidden.

steps.step: find the chain of links between two items
steps.here: Under 'Path to concept', a word or ILI is entered with suggestions offered. 'Find path' searches up to 12 relation steps and shows the chain as clickable concepts.

steps.step: look over every source at a glance
steps.here: The Wordnets tab is a sortable table of the merged resources. ⓘ opens a summary of one resource: metadata, part-of-speech breakdown, ILI coverage and relation counts with example pairs.

distinctive: Concepts are shared across 40+ languages through an interlingual index, so one concept page lists the words for it in every language.
Definitions fall back to another language when none exists in the chosen display language, and a badge marks the language shown and any machine translation.
Every sense, definition and relation can be traced to the source wordnet that contributed it through a separate provenance database that loads on demand.
The whole database runs in the browser as SQLite compiled to WebAssembly, with no server queries.
Relation names and colours come from a configuration file and can be shown in several display languages.

parts.title: Multi-mode search box
parts.summary: Takes a word, glob pattern, concept index id or definition phrase, detects which mode is meant and runs the matching query.

spans.first: <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 flex-grow min-w-48 pb-0.5">

parts.title: Language and part-of-speech filters
parts.summary: Restricts search results to chosen languages and parts of speech, and sets the language that definitions and labels are shown in.

parts.title: Search results
parts.summary: Lists the matching senses grouped by word and concept, each with its definition, and opens a sense or concept when clicked.

parts.title: Concept page
parts.summary: Shows everything about one concept: its definitions in several languages, examples, provenance, and every word that expresses it in each language.

parts.title: Related concepts graph
parts.summary: Draws the concept and its neighbours as a force-directed network with edges coloured by relation type, expands a node's relations on hover, and switches to a text list or off.

parts.title: Path to concept
parts.summary: Takes a target word or ILI with suggestions, then finds and shows the chain of relations (up to 12 steps) from the open concept to the target.

parts.title: Wordnets table and summary
parts.summary: Lists every merged source resource in a sortable table and opens a summary of one: metadata, part-of-speech breakdown, coverage and relation counts with examples.
